title: Cyient Limited (NSE: CYIENT) — Leveraged Deep-Tech Pivot, Stage 2 Tape & Dual Verdict
holding_rationale: Hold all 91 Zerodha shares (₹1,00,545.90 value, 2.34% weight, -0.83% vs ₹1,114.11 cost). Although the daily ledger flags Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) below the 50-DMA (₹1,120.11), price holds above the rising 30-week SMA (₹974.01). Keep a hard structural stop at ₹951.20. New capital must wait for ₹1,027.29–₹1,058.57 support, 50-DMA/4H reclaim, and Q3 FY27 debt below ₹2,500 Cr.

destinations.entry_condition: Deploy only on confirmed 4H turn inside ₹1,027.29–₹1,058.57 or Q3 FY27 deleveraging proof.

destinations.rationale: LTTS (CMP ₹4,247.20, 29.29x TTM P/E) carries higher historical ROE (20.4%) than CYIENT, but its current CMP R:R (0.64:1 vs ₹3,460.84 stop) does not clear our 1.50:1 hurdle.
destinations.entry_condition: Require pullback toward ₹3,850–₹3,950 support before considering outside ER&D entry.

primer: Cyient Limited is an Indian engineering R&D, electronics manufacturing, and custom semiconductor group. In 2026, management paired a Q2 FY27 DET margin rebound (14.2%) with ₹2,328 Cr of new debt to acquire Kinetic Technologies and TAO Digital. Borrowings rose 6.4x to ₹2,759 Cr, making execution and deleveraging the key watchpoints. New capital is gated at WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (₹1,027.29–₹1,058.57), while existing 91 Zerodha shares are held with a ₹951.20 stop.
